There was no light at all, making the world dim and dark, as quiet as a chaotic world. Many years ago, the Qing Dan Sect and his party saw the Qing Dan Sect surrounded by dense fog, and the mist-shrouded mountains. It was immediately obvious that there was a large formation guarding the peak, but Tianxuan Sect was a little strange. Could it be that the formation was secretive? "What do you mean! Fellow Taoist, you know in your heart, why do you need to talk so much!" The red jade rod faintly shouted from the fire tree. The voice was obviously extremely rude. Li Ling felt a little embarrassed when he saw this. This scene reminded him of the former head of state. When the latter gave a speech, the German people in the audience also had this kind of enthusiastic reaction. He practiced a variety of reincarnation realm secret techniques, including a silver armor level secret technique. He kept tapping the gorgeous marble table with his slender and powerful index finger, which had a strange bronze ring. The crowd immediately became noisy, and the people who knew Shikamaru looked clear, knowing that he was not willing to continue. A high-pitched dragon roar sounded. On Yao's body, a pair of green jade rings gradually grew larger, and the cold light flickered endlessly. Finally, they turned into a dragon and a dragon, roaring up to the sky, making the space in front of her seem to be turned upside down. The wind howled and the cold was raging. To destroy everything. All the demons were startled by the sudden hurricane and temporarily lost their defense. Even some big demons could not return to normal immediately. For a while, the entire area was blown into chaos by the hurricane.
